about: Play for free from 8/6 to 8/10! Your progression is saved if you decide to buy the game.

NEW MISSION IN THE WILDLANDS: LAST RITES
Return to a darker Bolivia to hunt La Llorona in a tense free new mission. Experience enhanced gameplay with 60FPS, 4K graphics, quality-of-life updates, new cosmetics, and more!
In a near future, Bolivia has fallen into the hands of a merciless drug cartel. Lead your team of elite soldiers and coordinate raids.
